description: Suit and trump color mapping for the Design 1 Latin-ornamental Tarot. Frame inks and the ground are exact values already used by the deck; accent targets are nominal art direction to be tuned against the first render. Titles, numbering, court labels, and upright/reversible policy are tracked separately and are not part of this palette manifest.
decision_status: Working proposal; supplied documents were not individually reviewed or approved by the user. Reusable components, recorded positioning, and the existing paired side panels are user requirements.
component_path_status: Planned component directories, not assertions that assets exist. Concrete component IDs, paths, anchors, and hashes belong in the future Tarot layout manifest.

frame_inks.source: scripts/frame_palette.py GROUNDS (digital labels, not measured ink)

accents.note: Nominal art-direction targets for the shared Design 1 vocabulary; label-level, tune against the first approved render. Turquoise is also the registration-dot color detected by expand_faces.py.

antique-gold.role: tracery, fine ornament, hilts, radiant discs

turquoise.role: jewel and detail accents; registration dot

suit_correspondence_rationale: Proposed visual mapping for this deck: Swords=Spades, Batons=Clubs, Cups=Hearts, Coins=Diamonds. This carries Design 1's two frame inks into Tarot (frame_palette.face_color: madder-lake for hearts/diamonds, lamp-black otherwise); adopting this Tarot mapping remains a review decision.

swords.emblem: sword family: straight double-edged blade and curved variants for interlace

trumps.rationale: Trumps belong to no suit, so they use the neutral black frame with gold ornament rather than a suit accent.

reversibility_default.note: Proposed defaults only; record per-card policy in the future Tarot production/layout manifest. Paired side indices rotate by 180 degrees independently of central artwork.

excludes.note: The 78-card Tarot inventory does not include the two French-suited Jokers.

open_decisions: Review of the proposed tradition and color mapping on representative composites
Accent hex tuning against the first approved render
Title spelling, trump order, and proposed side index vocabulary (component/layout contract; future production manifest)
